name: CINNARISINE 75 MG 60 TABLETS
description: This medication is widely prescribed to relieve the symptoms of dizziness and vertigo caused by various conditions, such as benign paroxysmal positional vertigo, Meniere’s disease, and other balance disorders. Cinnarizine works by dilating blood vessels, improving cerebral blood flow and reducing feelings of dizziness, nausea, and vertigo. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
